items.text: Optional write token — set NEXTDASH_WRITE_TOKEN on the server; destructive and health write APIs then require X-NextDash-Token. Config and Health pages send it automatically in the browser.
Localhost bookmarks — Config → General → Advanced → Allow localhost & private-network bookmarks (on by default for dev). Turn off if nextDash is reachable on a shared network.
Import hardening — ZIP restore skips bookmarks with invalid URLs and reports how many were skipped.
SSRF redirects — pings, link previews, and auto-heal only follow redirects to allowed hosts.
Search XSS — fuzzy match highlights and search metadata are escaped; bookmark icon filenames are validated on save.
Health write APIs — auto-heal apply, cache scan, and status persistence respect the write token when set.
Factory reset — reset all data no longer deadlocks while rebuilding default files.
Default bookmark favicons — on first install or factory reset, the server downloads favicons for the sample bookmarks before the dashboard loads, so icons are visible before onboarding starts.
:history — command mode lists recent searches; :history clear wipes all. Empty search also shows history with a × per row.
Extension write token — optional field in extension Settings when your server uses NEXTDASH_WRITE_TOKEN.
Locales & font size — DE/FR parity restored; legacy small/medium/large font sizes normalize to s/m/l.
Cleanup — removed obsolete standalone colors page template and other unused static assets.
